scope: Prevent the concrete DXF adapter from reinterpreting an entity as DRW_ModelerGeometry solely because its mutable public eType says 3DSOLID, REGION, or BODY.

behavior: The 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY callback path uses dynamic_cast<DRW_ModelerGeometry*> before invoking the modeler writer.
A mismatched runtime object follows the existing fail-closed callback path and cannot publish a partial DXF.
After correcting the eType on the same retained LINE object, the same adapter retries and writes a readable line.

validationProfile.source: A locally constructed DRW_Line is captured through the concrete adapter; only its public eType is mutated to each modeler tag. No DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
assertions: Every mismatched runtime/tag pair is refused.
Every refusal preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Every corrected same-adapter retry imports successfully and preserves the LINE endpoints.
validationProfile.identityNote: Generated DXF output assigns a new handle for this no-source LINE profile; the control verifies geometry and runtime type rather than requiring its authored handle to be preserved.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; six tag/encoding refusal and retry cells plus typed LINE readback, in 0.50 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This guards one adapter dispatch family only; it does not establish exhaustive BLOCK callback coverage.
It does not validate ACIS/SAB syntax, solid/region/body geometric meaning, native kernel behavior, or consumer support.
No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
